title_protection.quote: practice of medicine: (1) Includes attaching any of the following words or abbreviations to a name, either alone or in connection with other words or abbreviations indicating or inducing others to believe that the person is engaged in the practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices medicine or surgery in this state without having first complied with the provisions of this chapter commits a Class B misdemeanor for each instance of such practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional, dishonorable or unethical conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional, dishonorable or unethical conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or attempted violation of this chapter, any lawful board order, or any criminal statute of this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation or attempted violation, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter or, any lawful order of the board issued pursuant thereto or any criminal statute of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false statements or representations, fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false statements or representations, being guilty of fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or being guilty of fraud or deceit in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence in the course of medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence in the course of medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of drugs or intoxicating liquors in a manner adversely affecting ability to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of any drugs or the use of intoxicating liquors, narcotics, controlled substances, controlled substance analogues or other drugs or stimulants in such manner as to adversely affect the person's ability to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the laws governing abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the laws governing abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional secret
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional secret

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising medical business with untrue or misleading statements or causing publication of fraudulent advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising of medical business in which untrue or misleading statements are made or causing the publication or circulation of fraudulent advertising relative to any disease, human ailment or conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of board rules regulating advertising by practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of the rules and regulations promulgated by the board of medical examiners to regulate advertising by practitioners who are under the jurisdiction of such board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, drug-related offense, offense involving moral turpitude, or offense requiring sex offender registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, conviction of any offense under state or federal laws relative to drugs or the practice of medicine, conviction of any offense involving moral turpitude or conviction of any offense for which the person is required to register as a sexual offender or violent sexual offender

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or signing in one's professional capacity any certificate known to be false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or signing in one's professional capacity any certificate that is known to be false at the time one makes or signs such certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing, prescribing or distributing any controlled substance or drug not in the course of professional practice or not in good faith
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance or any other drug not in the course of professional practice, or not in good faith to relieve pain and suffering, or not to cure an ailment, physical infirmity or disease, or in amounts and/or for durations not medically necessary, advisable or justified for a diagnosed condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing or prescribing controlled substances to an addicted patient without a bona fide effort to cure the habit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing to any person a controlled substance or other drug if such person is addicted to the habit of using controlled substances without making a bona fide effort to cure the habit of such patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing, prescribing or distributing any controlled substance or drug in violation of state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance, controlled substance analogue or other drug to any person in violation of any law of the state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, undertaking or agreeing to cure or treat a disease by a secret means, method, device or instrumentality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking or agreeing to cure or treat a disease, injury, ailment or infirmity by a secret means, method, device or instrumentality

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving, or aiding or abetting the giving or receiving, of rebates
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving or receiving, or aiding or abetting the giving or receiving, of rebates, either directly or indirectly

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of medicine under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of medicine under a false or assumed name, or the impersonation of another practitioner, or a like, similar or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of medicine when mentally or physically unable to safely do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of medicine when mentally or physically unable to safely do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using radiation in treatment of noncancerous skin conditions without adequately warning the patient of cancer risk
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using radiation in the treatment of any noncancerous disease, disorder or condition of the skin without first adequately warning the patient of the extent of any known risk of cancer associated with such treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against the person by another state or territory for acts that would constitute grounds for discipline in Tennessee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against a person licensed to practice medicine by another state or territory of the United States for any acts or omissions that would constitute grounds for discipline of a person licensed in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transferring patient medical information to an unlicensed out-of-state person using electronic means if employed to diagnose/treat Tennessee patients (limited to X-rays and medical imaging)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Transferring of patient medical information to a person in another state who is not licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the state of Tennessee using any electronic, telephonic or fiber optic means or by any other method if such information is employed to diagnose and/or treat persons physically located within the state of Tennessee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Agreeing to pay a laboratory for anatomic pathology or cytology services and including such costs in patient bills without required disclosure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person licensed in this state to practice medicine shall agree or contract with any clinical, bioanalytical or hospital laboratory, wherever located, to pay such laboratory for anatomic pathology services or cytology services and thereafter include such costs in the bill or statement submitted to the patient or any entity or person for payment, unless the practitioner is in compliance with the requirements of § 56-7-1015(g) and discloses on the bill or statement

establishment_regulation_required.quote: a physician office surgical suite is required to be certified by the board in order to perform office-based surgery

definition_quote.value: Any person shall be regarded as practicing medicine within the meaning of this chapter who treats, or professes to diagnose, treat, operates on or prescribes for any physical ailment or any physical injury to or deformity of another.

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, dispense, and administer drugs including controlled substances in the course of professional practice. Prescriptions must be legible, signed, and issued on tamper-resistant paper. Prescribing controlled substances outside the course of professional practice or not in good faith is a disciplinary ground.
drug_authority.quote: Any handwritten prescription order for a drug prepared by a physician or surgeon who is authorized by law to prescribe a drug must be legible so that it is comprehensible by the pharmacist who fills the prescription.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical school graduates must provide: (1) a certificate from a medical school whose curriculum is judged acceptable by the board; (2) a permanent ECFMG certificate; (3) evidence of good moral character; (4) citizenship/work authorization; and (5) evidence of satisfactory completion of a three-year post-graduate training program approved by the AMA. Alternatively, a foreign training license may be issued to an IMG who completed a 3-year postgraduate program in their licensing country and practiced as a physician for the last 3 years outside the US, with a pathway to full licensure after 2 years of active practice in Tennessee.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A copy of a permanent Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) certificate

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: A one-year United States training program approved by the American Medical Association or its extant accreditation program for medical education, or its successor

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: The board has authority to issue restricted licenses and special licenses based upon licensure to another state for the limited purpose of authorizing the practice of telemedicine. Transfer of patient medical information to an out-of-state unlicensed person for diagnosis/treatment of Tennessee patients constitutes the practice of medicine (limited to X-rays and medical imaging).
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: the board has the authority to issue restricted licenses and special licenses based upon licensure to another state for the limited purpose of authorizing the practice of telemedicine to current applicants or current licensees

telemedicine_license_available.quote: the board has the authority to issue restricted licenses and special licenses based upon licensure to another state for the limited purpose of authorizing the practice of telemedicine to current applicants or current licensees, or both, as it deems necessary

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: service rendered by a physician assistant practicing in collaboration with a physician, osteopathic physician, or podiatrist in accordance with the requirements of title 63, chapter 19, whether through protocols or a collaborative agreement

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe drugs (including controlled substances except as limited by collaborative agreement) pursuant to protocols or a collaborative agreement with a supervising physician. Graduate physicians (a separate category) may not prescribe controlled substances.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: service rendered by a physician assistant practicing in collaboration with a physician, osteopathic physician, or podiatrist in accordance with the requirements of title 63, chapter 19, whether through protocols or a collaborative agreement

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A collaborating physician shall not enter into a graduate physician collaborative practice arrangement with more than three (3) graduate physicians at the same time.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Regulatory boards, commissions and agencies attached to the division of health related boards, in addition to other enumerated powers and duties, have as their purpose assistance in the rehabilitation of impaired health practitioners who are licensed, certified or registered by the respective regulatory boards, commissions and agencies.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board shall, upon probable cause, have authority to compel an applicant or licensee to submit to a mental and/or physical examination by a designated committee of at least three (3) practicing physicians

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board is authorized in its discretion to issue limited licenses to physicians who have been out of clinical practice for an extended period of time or who have been, or are at the time of their application, engaged exclusively in administrative medicine.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board also has the authority to issue locum tenens and/or conditional licenses as it deems appropriate after reviewing the qualifications of applicants.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A licensing board or disciplinary subcommittee shall not revoke, fail to renew, suspend, or take any action against a healthcare provider's license issued under this title, based solely on the healthcare provider's recommendations to an eligible patient regarding access to or treatment with an investigational drug, biological product, or device.
